verdict.rationale: Segment's sources catalog lists a third-party cloud-app source (Shopify, partner-built by Fueled), and its docs claim it can 'capture data from any source'. Source Functions let users build custom sources for other feeds, but that is a building block rather than a ready connector. Only one cloud-app source is evidenced, with no detail on how it ingests data. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of first-party cloud-app sources (CRM, ticketing, payments, etc.), details on how those sources sync (schedules, objects pulled), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can pull customer data in from third-party cloud apps and feeds — not just my own instrumented apps

citations.quote: Functions let you create your own sources and destinations directly within your workspace to bring new types of data into Segment
